senses.gloss: SV0078 दक्षिणयन्/विसर्गकाल dakṣiṇayan/visargakāla Southern solstice -It indicates the decent of sun/ movement of sun. This movement gives strength. Movement which enhances āp principles and strength of all living beings is Visarga kala. Varsha, Sarat and Hemanta constitute the Dakshinayan.
